policies.using: ((NOT ( SELECT is_staff_or_admin() AS is_staff_or_admin)) OR ( SELECT is_platform_master() AS is_platform_master) OR (organization_id = ( SELECT get_user_organization_id() AS get_user_organization_id)) OR ((organization_id IS NULL) AND (( SELECT get_user_organization_id() AS get_user_organization_id) = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)))

policies.name: reservations_insert_strict
policies.check:
((organization_id = ( SELECT se.organization_id
   FROM schedule_events se
  WHERE (se.id = reservations.schedule_event_id))) AND (((get_user_organization_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (organization_id = get_user_organization_id())) OR is_org_admin() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM customers c
  WHERE ((c.id = reservations.customer_id) AND (c.user_id = auth.uid()))))))

policies.name: reservations_select_self_or_admin
policies.using:
((is_admin() AND (organization_id = get_user_organization_id())) OR (customer_id IN ( SELECT customers.id
   FROM customers
  WHERE (customers.user_id = auth.uid()))))
